about: Every SYMMIO deployment perps-core-ui knows. Each thing is written once: chains, role candidates and frontends at the top, then one entry per deployment. The fields are explained in perps-core-ui/README.md under “The address book”.

deployments.name: Base
notes: The NFT Manager proxy, proxy admin and timelock are shared Base infrastructure used by Vibe Arbitrum production and staging.

deployments.name: Vibe Arbitrum
notes: Uses the shared NFT Manager on Base (chain 8453), listed under the Base deployment. Its proxy, proxy admin and timelock are not Arbitrum contracts.
